name: EPIC 206063962
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 11.7 solar radii and 1.07 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 206063962 (K2 campaign 3): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.662052 (16th-84th percentiles 11.130725-12.382175), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,225 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 1.07 solar masses and 11.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,930 K at its surface.
